versions.changelog:
Initial release of the U9C report merger skill.

- Automatically identifies and merges any number of U9C export Excel files into a standardized "超时停滞单据" report.
- Supports classification and combination of five distinct document types by file name prefix.
- Unified column mapping and output formatting, including fixed sectional order and styling.
- Handles missing file types, skipping empty sections as needed.
- Provides usage via folder scanning, specified file lists, or command-line interface.
- Outputs a single formatted Excel file, ready for compliance and review.
